title: Tiny, cute helicopter
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- main rotor -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='20' rx='38' ry='4' fill='#66ccff'/>
  <rect x='48' y='18' width='4' height='10' rx='2' fill='#88aaff'/>
  <!-- rotor hub -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='22' r='5' fill='#5599ee'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='22' r='2.5' fill='#aaddff'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='28' ry='20' fill='#ffcc33'/>
  <!-- body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='22' ry='13' fill='#ffdd66'/>
  <!-- tail boom -->
  <rect x='68' y='48' width='22' height='7' rx='3' fill='#ffaa22'/>
  <!-- tail rotor -->
  <ellipse cx='92' cy='51' rx='3' ry='10' fill='#66ccff'/>
  <circle cx='92' cy='51' r='2.5' fill='#aaddff'/>
  <!-- cockpit window -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='47' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#55ddff'/>
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='44' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#bbeeff'/>
  <!-- window shine -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='42' rx='2' ry='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- skids -->
  <rect x='30' y='70' width='38' height='4' rx='2' fill='#888888'/>
  <rect x='34' y='66' width='4' height='8' rx='2' fill='#999999'/>
  <rect x='60' y='66' width='4' height='8' rx='2' fill='#999999'/>
  <!-- skid highlights -->
  <rect x='32' y='71' width='34' height='1.5' rx='1' fill='#bbbbbb'/>
  <!-- cute face on body -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='55' r='2.5' fill='#333355'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='55' r='2.5' fill='#333355'/>
  <circle cx='42.8' cy='54' r='0.9' fill='#aaddff'/>
  <circle cx='58.8' cy='54' r='0.9' fill='#aaddff'/>
  <path d='M46 61 Q50 65 54 61' stroke='#cc7722' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx='37' cy='59' r='3' fill='#ff9966' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='59' r='3' fill='#ff9966' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- small stripe detail -->
  <rect x='35' y='66' width='30' height='2' rx='1' fill='#eeaa22'/>
</svg>
